represents: One device (GPU etc.) requirement a charm declares in its metadata, with min/max count.
enforced_by: FK charm_uuid -> charm; PK (charm_uuid, key)
on_removal: deleted with the charm (explicit delete in deleteCharm)

represents: The storage constraints (pool, size, count) the application uses for each storage name its charm defines, i.e. what 'juju deploy --storage' sets.
cannot_exist_without: application (also the charm's storage definition and a storage pool)
enforced_by: FK application_uuid -> application; composite FK (charm_uuid, storage_name) -> charm_storage; FK storage_pool
on_removal: deleted with the application; rewritten on charm refresh

represents: Migration checkpoint: the latest log timestamp received for a model during migration log transfer, so the transfer can resume. At most one row per model DB.
enforced_by: FK uuid -> model(uuid); one row per model database
on_removal: lives in the model's own database; no explicit delete code, excluded from export/import (controller-local), goes when the model DB goes

represents: Default model-config key/values set for all models on a cloud (juju model-defaults <cloud> key=val).
enforced_by: FK cloud_uuid -> cloud; PK (cloud_uuid,key)
on_removal: not deleted by DeleteCloud, so the FK makes removal of a cloud with defaults fail; rows are removed only by explicit unset. Cloud removal is also refused while models use it.

represents: Key/value state a charm saves for itself on a unit (state-set/uniter charm state).
enforced_by: FK unit_uuid -> unit; PK (unit_uuid,key)
on_removal: deleted with the unit; also reset when a unit is reprovisioned (replacement unit starts empty)

represents: An authentication type a cloud supports (e.g. userpass, oauth2); join of cloud to auth type.
enforced_by: FK cloud_uuid -> cloud; FK auth_type_id -> auth_type; PK (cloud_uuid, auth_type_id)
on_removal: deleted with the cloud (explicit delete in DeleteCloud); cloud removal itself refused while models use it

represents: Link saying an operation (a 'juju run' / action invocation) is for a specific charm action.
cannot_exist_without: operation (and the charm action it names)
enforced_by: FK operation_uuid -> operation (PK); composite FK (charm_uuid, charm_action_key) -> charm_action
on_removal: deleted with the operation (operation pruning); a charm cannot be deleted by deleteCharm without deleting charm_action, which this FK would block while operations exist

represents: The storage constraints (pool, size, count) for a unit per storage name; normally the application's, may temporarily diverge when the unit's charm differs.
cannot_exist_without: unit (also charm storage and storage pool)
enforced_by: FK unit_uuid -> unit; composite FK (charm_uuid, storage_name) -> charm_storage; FK storage_pool
on_removal: deleted with the unit; deleted for the old charm on unit charm change; moved to the replacement unit on reprovision

represents: Which secret backend a model uses to store its secrets (model config secret-backend).
enforced_by: model_uuid is PK and FK -> model; FK secret_backend_uuid -> secret_backend
on_removal: deleted with the model; backend removal blocked while referenced by FK

represents: Default model-config key/values for all models in one region of a cloud.
enforced_by: FK region_uuid -> cloud_region; PK (region_uuid,key)
on_removal: not deleted by DeleteCloud (which deletes regions first), so the FK would make that fail while region defaults exist; rows are removed only by explicit unset

represents: Status (state, message, data, time) of the application's operator/controller-side presence, shown for Kubernetes sidecar-style apps; a row per application.
enforced_by: application_uuid is PK and FK -> application; FK status_id
on_removal: deleted with the application

represents: The SSH host key Juju presents for a machine through the controller's virtual SSH host, used by 'juju ssh' to verify the machine.
enforced_by: machine_uuid is PK and FK -> machine; FK algorithm type
on_removal: deleted with the machine

represents: The macaroon used to authenticate a cross-model relation against the offering model (consumer side).
enforced_by: relation_uuid is PK and FK -> relation
on_removal: deleted with the relation (remote-offerer relation removal)

represents: Flag that a machine has asked for a reboot (juju-reboot), with time requested.
enforced_by: machine_uuid is PK and FK -> machine
on_removal: deleted with the machine; also cleared when the reboot is handled

represents: User-set free-form key/value annotation on a charm.
enforced_by: FK uuid -> charm; PK (uuid,key)
on_removal: not deleted in deleteCharm (list omits it), so FK would refuse deleting an annotated charm; only deleted by explicit annotation unset

represents: The checksum (sha256) of a charm's archive.
enforced_by: charm_uuid is PK and FK -> charm; FK hash_kind
on_removal: deleted with the charm

represents: The SSH host key Juju presents for a unit through the virtual SSH host, used by 'juju ssh <unit>'.
enforced_by: unit_uuid is PK and FK -> unit; FK algorithm type
on_removal: deleted with the unit

represents: User-set free-form key/value annotation on a unit.
enforced_by: FK uuid -> unit; PK (uuid,key)
on_removal: deleted with the unit; moved to replacement unit on reprovision

represents: Who supplied a resource's content: the user who uploaded it, or the unit/application that downloaded it from a repository.
enforced_by: resource_uuid is PK and FK -> resource; FK retrieved_by_type
on_removal: deleted with the resource (application removal / resource deletion); copied to the replacement resource on update

represents: How many units the application should have (scale, target, scaling in progress, start ordinal): what 'juju add-unit/scale-application' changes.
enforced_by: application_uuid is PK and FK -> application
on_removal: deleted with the application
